description: Full-stack telemetry for Cloud Yatra, end to end: live service pulse, Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend health (metrics, logs, traces), browser real-user monitoring, game performance, gameplay analytics, and the shared leaderboard. Frontend via Faro; backend via Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo; database via Infinity.
title: Cloud Yatra · Live Observatory

options.content:
Cloud Yatra · Live Observatory क्लाउड यात्रा
Namaste! Every panel here is real traffic from a small platformer about Yatri, a traveller climbing from the Terai jungle through the Pahad hills to the Himalaya. Play the game above and watch these numbers move.
Live now is the headline. The climb shows how far pilgrims get. Yatri's journey breaks down life on the trail. Scores is the shared leaderboard, Around the world maps where people play, and Chaos Mode is where I break my own backend on purpose to watch it recover.

options.content:
The game
Phaser in the browser, served from Cloudflare Pages. Every sprite and note is drawn in code.
The backend
A Cloudflare Worker validates gameplay events and stores them in D1 (SQLite), which feeds these panels through Infinity.
The signals
Faro for real-user monitoring, Prometheus for metrics, Loki for logs and Tempo for traces, all in Grafana Cloud.
The cost
Free tiers only: Cloudflare Pages, Workers and D1, plus Grafana Cloud free.
